description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language of the response. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English.
Specifies whether to enable the swimming lane.

description.zh: 是否配置泳道的路由规则，Ingress为网关暂时不需要配置。
description.en: Specifies whether to configure a routing rule for the swimming lane. You do not need to configure a routing rule for an Ingress.
The collection of swimming lane rules.

description.zh: 指示RestItems如何组合成最终的条件
description.en: Specifies how to combine the RestItems to form the final condition.

description.zh: 网关路由信息（使用云原生网关为入口时使用）
description.en: The gateway routing information. This parameter is used when you use a cloud-native gateway as the ingress.
The ID of the swimming lane group.

description.zh: 主键ID。-1时为创建泳道，大于0时为修改指定泳道。
description.en: The primary key ID. Set the value to -1 to create a swimming lane. Set the value to a number greater than 0 to modify a specific swimming lane.
The name of the swimming lane.
The name of the MSE namespace.

description.zh: 已废弃。Java网关相关配置，Path按比例路由
description.en: This parameter is deprecated. This parameter is a configuration item for Java gateways and is used for path-based routing by percentage.
